related.title: EDNS Client Subnet：快取切分與隱私取捨
related.titleEn: EDNS Client Subnet: cache partitioning and privacy tradeoffs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受可重現新快照的完整鏈；10%/3%不含封裝及SOA成本。 交接時須能核對：交付 ixfr-deltas.csv、每版集合摘要與AXFR對照驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept only a complete chain reproducing the new snapshot;10%/3% exclude framing and SOA overhead. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver ixfr-deltas.csv, per-version set summaries and AXFR comparison evidence.
related.difference: 以name、type、ECS family/source/scope建快取鍵，不僅用名稱查表。
related.differenceEn: Key records by name, type and ECS family/source/scope instead of name alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
IXFR以區域版本差異傳送變更；增量鏈缺失時不能任意跳過中間版本。
教學基準：(400+600)*120/1200000*100 = 10 %；對照：(100+200)*120/1200000*100 = 3 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

ECS會依客戶子網及scope切分快取；更細的前綴可增加快取變體並暴露更多位置資訊。
教學基準：100*2**(24-16) = 25600 entries；對照：100*2**(20-16) = 1600 entries。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
IXFR transfers zone-version changes; a missing delta cannot be skipped arbitrarily.
Teaching baseline: (400+600)*120/1200000*100 = 10 %; comparison: (100+200)*120/1200000*100 = 3 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

ECS partitions caches using client subnet and scope; finer prefixes can increase variants and reveal more location information.
Teaching baseline: 100*2**(24-16) = 25600 entries; comparison: 100*2**(20-16) = 1600 entries. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: RACK-TLP：時間式重排序容忍
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受可重現新快照的完整鏈；10%/3%不含封裝及SOA成本。 交接時須能核對：交付 ixfr-deltas.csv、每版集合摘要與AXFR對照驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept only a complete chain reproducing the new snapshot;10%/3% exclude framing and SOA overhead. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver ixfr-deltas.csv, per-version set summaries and AXFR comparison evidence.
related.difference: 記錄每段傳送時間、ACK時間及最近已交付段；本題只研究時間gate，不冒充完整RACK。
related.differenceEn: Record send/ACK times and the latest delivered segment; study only the time gate, not a complete RACK implementation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

RACK利用已確認資料的傳送時間推論遺失；重排序窗口避免把所有晚到封包當遺失。
教學基準：12-5 = 7 ms margin；對照：12-15 = -3 ms margin。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

RACK uses transmission times of acknowledged data to infer loss; a reordering window prevents treating every late packet as lost.
Teaching baseline: 12-5 = 7 ms margin; comparison: 12-15 = -3 ms margin. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
